primary_analysis: Confirmatory paired-binary analysis using verifier pass booleans from execution/scoring/task-000***-*.json (baseline, guarded) as recorded in execution/raw_results.jsonl and execution/scoring/. Compute absolute paired difference (guarded − baseline), report two-sided McNemar p-value (α=0.05), exact 95% CI for the absolute difference (executor-implemented exact/binomial or paired CI), discordant-pair counts, and N after preregistered deterministic exclusions. All inputs are taken from execution/* artifacts listed in the execution manifest.
secondary_analyses: Per-stratum descriptive pass rates (small/medium/large; n=80 each) with counts and exact 95% CIs (Clopper–Pearson) sourced from execution/scoring/*.json and execution/task_manifest.jsonl.
Overall per-condition (baseline, guarded) pass rates and counts (execution/scoring/*.json).

Median and IQR of model calls per successful repair (cost-per-success) computed from execution/provider_calls and execution/scoring artifacts; report bootstrap CIs for medians if implemented by executor.
Contamination-stratified pass rates: report pass rates for tasks flagged 'none' / 'possible-contamination' / 'likely-contamination' using transformation_manifest and scoring outputs.
sensitivity_analyses: Missingness sensitivity: complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity (treat excluded technical model/API failures as verifier-fail) applied to the primary estimand per preregistration.
Contamination exclusion sensitivities: rerun primary estimand excluding items meeting 'possible-contamination' and separately excluding 'likely-contamination' (threshold sweep reported).
Parser-fail sensitivity: treat parser/canonicalizer parse-fail items as verifier-fail and report effect on primary estimand.
Observed-discordance sensitivity: recompute achieved 95% CIs and minimum-detectable-effect conditional on observed discordant counts as preregistered.
uncertainty_quantification: Report exact 95% CIs for proportions (Clopper–Pearson). For the paired absolute difference use the executor's exact/binomial paired CI or nonparametric bootstrap (as implemented). Report two-sided McNemar p-value and exact discordant counts. For medians report median, IQR, and bootstrap CIs where implemented by the executor.
multiplicity_implementation: One preregistered primary test (paired difference) treated as confirmatory. Other analyses are exploratory/descriptive except the preregistered stratified descriptive reporting. If any secondary tests are promoted as confirmatory apply Bonferroni correction across those named secondary tests; otherwise present unadjusted p-values with explicit exploratory labeling.
contamination_analysis: Use repository contamination outputs (exact-line match counts via line-hash, normalized 5-gram overlap, token-shingle Jaccard) from transformation_manifest and scoring JSONs. Apply preregistered thresholds: flag 'possible-contamination' if exact-line matches ≥2 OR normalized 5-gram overlap >0.30; flag 'likely-contamination' if exact-line matches ≥5 OR normalized 5-gram overlap >0.60. Primary analysis includes all items; report contamination-stratified results and perform sensitivity analyses excluding flagged sets and threshold sweeps. Provide contamination-flag table and audit samples from execution artifacts.
table_specifications: Table 1 — Overall paired contingency table: counts for (baseline pass / guarded pass) cells and discordant-pair counts (sourced from execution/scoring/task-000***.json).

Table 2 — Per-stratum pass rates: for small/medium/large strata report baseline and guarded pass counts, proportions, and 95% CIs (derived from execution/scoring files and execution/task_manifest.jsonl).

Table 3 — Contamination flags: per-task contamination metrics (exact-line match count, normalized 5-gram overlap, shingle Jaccard) and assigned flag (none/possible/likely) pulled from transformation_manifest and scoring outputs.

Table 4 — Model-call cost: per-task model-call counts and summary distribution (median, IQR) and counts of successful repairs with associated calls (from execution/provider_calls and execution/scoring).

Table 5 — Sensitivity-summary: primary result under main treatment, missing-as-fail sensitivity, contamination-excluded sensitivities, parser-fail-as-fail sensitivity with counts and effect estimates.
